name: PostExtra –  Gutenberg Post Blocks Plugin for Block Editor & FSE (Post Grid, Post Carousel, Post List, Recent Posts)
author: Anant Sites

sections.description:
PostExtra is a flexible and performance-optimized Gutenberg plugin built for displaying blog posts in beautiful layouts like Post Grids, Post Lists, and Carousels. Whether you’re running a personal blog, magazine, or content-rich website, PostExtra provides everything you need — no coding required.

With full support for Full Site Editing (FSE), the plugin includes drag-and-drop builders for headers, footers, archives, single posts, and even full site templates. It’s ideal for bloggers, marketers, and developers looking for clean, responsive, and fast-loading Gutenberg blocks.

Key Features:

✔️ 38+ Gutenberg Blocks for posts
✔️ Post Grid, Post Carousel, Post List, Recent Posts
✔️ Full Site Editing (FSE) Support
✔️ Single Post & Archive Builder
✔️ Header & Footer Builder
✔️ Copy-paste block styles
✔️ Optimized for speed and SEO
✔️ Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
✔️ Clean, modular, and lightweight

Built for Speed and Customization

PostExtra uses only the necessary assets for active blocks, ensuring fast page loads and excellent Core Web Vitals performance.

Block-Level Control

Enable or disable specific blocks from the dashboard to keep your site lean and optimized.

Beginner-Friendly, Developer-Ready

Simple enough for beginners and powerful enough for developers to extend with filters and hooks.

🚀 Readymade Starter Sites from Anant Sites

Build your website fast with these Gutenberg-compatible starter templates:

  • Personal Blog (Free)
  • Blog Sport (Free)
  • Fashion Blog (Free)
  • Post Blog Pro (Pro)
  • Tech Blog (Pro)
  • Lifestyle Blog (Pro)
  • Blog Fashion (Pro)
  • Newspaper (Pro)
  • More templates coming soon!

🔑 Key Blocks Included

  • Post Grid (1 & 2)
  • Post Carousel
  • Post List (1 & 2)
  • News Ticker
  • Social Icons
  • Heading, Section, Column, Paragraph
  • Advanced Image, Creative Button
  • Taxonomy Filter
  • Pagination, Title Trimming, and more

👥 Compatible Themes

  • PostBlog – FSE Blog Theme
  • Eshop Elementor
  • Shopsaas Elementor
  • Astra, Blocksy, GeneratePress, Neve, and any Gutenberg-compatible theme

💼 Related Plugins by Anant Sites

  • Anant Sites – Starter Templates
  • Anant Addons for Elementor
  • Gutenwave Blocks
  • Anant Team Member Block

FAQs

Is PostExtra compatible with Full Site Editing (FSE)?

  • Yes! PostExtra is built with full support for WordPress Full Site Editing and the block editor.

Does it work with any theme?

  • Yes, PostExtra is theme-agnostic and works with all modern WordPress themes.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

  • No. PostExtra is performance-optimized and only loads assets as needed. Unused blocks can be disabled from the dashboard.

Is it responsive?

  • Yes, all blocks are mobile-responsive and tested across devices and browsers.

Are there any plugin dependencies?

  • Only the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg) is required.
